title: GTA 6's Wildlife Is Insane
description:
Rockstar's official GTA 6 screenshots already show iguanas in the Leonida Keys, sea turtles on the reefs, alligators in the Grassrivers and a panther stalking deer in Mount Kalaga. GTA 6 launches November 19 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.

Map is fan-made and spots are estimates. Screenshots: Rockstar Games.

#GTA6 #GTAVI #Leonida #ViceCity #Rockstar

lines.text: GTA 6 isn't just gangs and fast cars.
Rockstar's own screenshots show Leonida is packed with wildlife.
Down in the Leonida Keys, giant iguanas just chill on the rocks.
Dive under the water and there are sea turtles swimming past the divers.
Head into the Grassrivers and the locals hang out with real alligators.
And way up north in Mount Kalaga, a panther stalks deer by the water.
If this is just the screenshots, imagine the full map.
Which animal are you finding first?
